skill.name: ki-register-use-case-documenter
skill.description: Document AI use cases for EU AI Act governance, inspect code or interview users, then validate and submit confirmed manifests to KI-Register.
skill.summary: Create evidence-backed KI-Register AI use case records for governance review.
skill.author: Egonso

security_audit.summary: The skill documents and validates KI-Register AI use cases, and no prompt injection or malicious social engineering was found in SKILL.md. Confirmed risks are expected secret handling, selected local CLI execution, and a confirmation-gated network submission endpoint. Most backtick findings are markdown paths, values, or documentation references.

remediation.issue: API key handling is required for submissions.
remediation.suggestion: Avoid inline shell examples that include secrets. Prefer a secret manager, secure prompt, or documented environment setup outside shell history.

remediation.issue: The workflow runs local Node and studio-agent commands.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval before command execution and document that users should run only trusted Agent Kit installations.

remediation.issue: Manifest submission sends governance data to KI-Register.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the confirmation gate and state which manifest data is sent before every submit action.

content.value_statement: AI governance teams need complete use case records for review and audits. This skill gathers evidence, validates manifests, and submits confirmed records to KI-Register.
actual_capabilities: Inspects local repositories for evidence about AI applications, processes, and workflows.
Interviews stakeholders to capture purpose, owners, data categories, decisions, controls, and artifacts.
Creates a manifest and review README under docs/agent-workflows for each use case.
Validates manifests with the studio-agent CLI before submission.
Submits confirmed manifests to KI-Register when API credentials and register details are available.
Marks unclear facts as missing instead of inventing unsupported details.
limitations: It is not legal advice or a conformity assessment.
It needs valid KI-Register credentials for submission.
It depends on available code, documentation, or stakeholder answers.
It does not decide uncertain EU AI Act risk classes without review.

use_cases.title: Prepare Governance Records
use_cases.description: Create structured AI use case documentation before internal reviews, audits, or procurement checks.

use_cases.title: Map Product AI Workflows
use_cases.description: Turn product behavior, users, decision points, and controls into a review-ready KI-Register record.

use_cases.title: Document Evidence From Code
use_cases.description: Inspect routes, prompts, configs, tests, and docs to draft evidence-backed AI workflow manifests.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Use Case Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a draft KI-Register use case for this project. Inspect the available files and list missing facts for me to answer.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Stakeholder Interview
prompt_templates.scenario: Capture a process that is not visible in files.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to interview me about an AI workflow. Ask one question at a time and build a KI-Register use case record from my answers.

prompt_templates.title: Validate an Existing Manifest
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to validate the existing use case manifest and README. Identify missing evidence, unclear fields, and next actions before submission.

prompt_templates.title: Submit a Confirmed Record
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review the completed manifest, show me the submission summary, wait for confirmation, then submit it to KI-Register using available credentials.

output_examples.input: A product repository includes AI review routes, prompts, and workflow documentation.
output_examples.output: A draft use case record with purpose, owner role, systems, data categories, decision influence, controls, evidence, and missing items.

output_examples.input: A compliance manager describes a supplier screening process during an interview.
output_examples.output: A structured KI-Register-ready summary that separates confirmed facts from open questions and review blockers.

output_examples.input: A completed manifest needs final validation and submission.
output_examples.output: A validation result, a human-readable submission summary, and a confirmation request before sending the record.

best_practices: Provide repository access, process notes, and known owners before starting a draft.
Confirm every inferred fact before submission to KI-Register.
Store API keys in environment variables or secret stores, not generated files.
anti_patterns: Do not submit inferred records without human confirmation.
Do not use this skill as a substitute for legal advice.
Do not place API keys in manifests, README files, screenshots, or logs.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates a structured AI use case manifest and a human-readable README for KI-Register review.

faq.question: Can it inspect a codebase?
faq.answer: Yes. It can inspect local files and use only evidence-backed facts in the draft record.

faq.question: Can it interview nontechnical users?
faq.answer: Yes. It can ask focused questions about purpose, owners, data, decisions, controls, and artifacts.

faq.question: Does it provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It supports structured governance documentation, but legal and conformity decisions need qualified review.

faq.question: When does it submit to KI-Register?
faq.answer: It submits only after local validation, available credentials, and explicit human confirmation.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
